title: In Memoriam of Kylene Beers: Remembering Kylene Beers 1957–2025
text_snippet: In Memoriam of Kylene Beers: Remembering Kylene Beers 1957–2025 Within this issue of Voices , the editors have created space to celebrate and honor the contributions Kylene Beers has made not only to the profession but to the National Council of Teachers of English. She was a fixture within NCTE and particularly within Voices from the Middle . We hope you enjoy reading the stories of some of the people who remain profoundly touched by her work.
